//: The API. Apply with: northflank create service combined --project beff -f deploy/northflank/service-api.json
//target: There is deliberately NO dockerfileTarget here, and that is not an omission. Northflank's SERVICE api accepts the field and silently discards it — it round-trips as absent, with no error, on both create and `update service build-options`. Its JOB api honours it, which is why job-migrate.json can still name `migrate`. The guarantee therefore lives in the Dockerfile instead: `prod` is declared LAST, so a target-less build produces the image that serves traffic rather than the migration one. Verified by building with no --target and asserting the result has no alembic.ini and a uvicorn CMD.
//command: configType `default` means the image's own CMD: uvicorn with --proxy-headers, which is what lets the rate limiter read the real client IP from X-Forwarded-For behind Northflank's load balancer.
name: beff-api
//description: Plain ASCII only. Northflank validates descriptions against /^[a-zA-Z0-9.,?\s\/'"()[\];`%^&*\-_:!]+$/, so an em-dash is rejected outright.
description: FastAPI - auth, onboarding, GDPR rights, production metrics.
